fixes.explanation: That's the reason the text gives, baker. “for this is a people without understanding.” Then it says their Maker has no compassion on them and their Creator shows them no favor (Isaiah 27:11). I think this one is a hard verse to sit with, and the reason sits right there next to it so nobody has to guess.
